label: source-derived operation counts per completed attempt, not dynamic counters or formal cost proofs
notes: SHA256 leaf input: two domain bytes + value + 32-byte salt; SHA256 parent: one domain byte + two 32-byte children. Padding included in compression count.
Folded tree still hashes 262144 leaves: only first 65536 carry evaluated values; padded leaves have different private salts and cannot share one leaf hash.
Salt count includes full folded padded domain. Each salt derives an identical-per-attempt binding hash followed by its unique leaf hash.
Mask expanders, seed derivation, transcript, challenge sampling, multiproof verification and all retries add other calls; total above is not total prover hashing.
Retries require independent secrets and redoing secret-dependent commitments; these counts multiply by completed construction attempts, not necessarily every early failed attempt.
